title: Enter Prometheus data source authentication credentials

whenTrue.title: Enter Prometheus data source authentication credentials

blocks.content: Every time Grafana Cloud queries your Prometheus data source, the security settings you have configured for that data source dictate whether the query can successfully execute and retrieve data from the Prometheus database.
Your Prometheus instance's security configuration may be basic, use OAuth, or have no security at all.

> **Did you know?** Authentication is set up on the Prometheus server during its initial configuration. To complete this step, you need to know which type of authentication it uses and have the corresponding credentials.
If you've configured Prometheus to require authentication, complete the following steps:

blocks.tooltip: Basic authentication adds User and Password fields for the credentials your Prometheus server itself expects, not your Grafana Cloud login; a bare local Prometheus usually needs No authentication.
blocks.content:
In the **Authentication method** dropdown, select the method your Prometheus server enforces.

For example, **Basic authentication** adds a **User** field for the Prometheus account name and a **Password** field for that account's password. Enter both yourself — this guide never fills in credentials.
In the next step of your journey, you'll select a PDC agent.
